query: Vince Phillips held a junior welterweight title by an organization recognized by what larger Hall of Fame?

pipeline_result.response: Vince Phillips held a junior welterweight title by the International Boxing Federation (IBF) against the International Boxing Council (IBC) in 1997. The IBC is one of four major organizations recognized by the International Boxing Hall of Fame, alongside the World Boxing Association (WBA), World Boxing Council (WBC), and World Boxing Organization (WBO).
retrieved_context: Vince Phillips: Vincent Edwards "Vince" Phillips (born July 23, 1963) is an American former professional boxer who competed from 1989 to 2007.  He held the IBF junior welterweight title from 1997 to 1999, notably scoring an upset victory against then-undefeated Kostya Tszyu to become champion.

International Boxing Federation: The International Boxing Federation (IBF) is one of four major organizations recognized by the International Boxing Hall of Fame (IBHOF) which sanction world championship boxing bouts, alongside the World Boxing Association (WBA), World Boxing Council (WBC) and World Boxing Organization (WBO).
